verdict_reason: Present PE sits right at own historical median and near the low end of its 6yr range, but only 7yr EPS depth (not full 10yr CAPE) and one outlier early-listing year (146 PE, thin liquidity) distort the average -- median is the more trustworthy anchor here and it says fairly priced, not cheap.
devils_advocate: EPS is erratic, not smoothly compounding: 31.04 (078-079) -> 11.88 (080-081) during the NEA arbitration dispute -> 23.72 -> 22.52, so the 'cheap vs Shiller' read may just be catching a still-recovering earnings base rather than genuine undervaluation. Promoter lock-in just expired to 100% float (2026-08-10 correction) with no verified conversion event on record -- a wave of former-promoter selling into a thin-volume stock could pressure price below what this backward-looking PE band assumes.
peg_caveat: Window-dependent: 3yr CAGR (079-080->082-083) gives only 6.0%/yr -> PEG 4.45. 1yr (081-082->082-083) is -5.1% (EPS fell) -> PEG undefined. The 0.83 headline is flattered by a low 076-077 base year and the 078-079 spike; true picture is closer to PEG 1.5-4 depending on window, not statistically cheap on a growth-adjusted basis.
forward_peg_basis: No management EPS/profit growth % guidance found in annual/quarterly reports (checked via NotebookLM) -- only capacity targets (47MW -> 124MW via Mistri Khola-2 12MW + Dudh Khola 65MW). Forward PEG estimated from an unverified 10-15% net EPS CAGR assumption, NOT company-sourced. Low confidence.
forward_peg_devils_advocate: Capacity growth (+164%) is not a proxy for EPS growth here: Dudh Khola (65MW) is being funded via a 1:1 rights issue -- shares outstanding roughly double before that plant generates revenue. Naive capacity-based forward PEG would be wrong by a wide margin; post-dilution EPS growth could be flat or negative for 2-4 years until Dudh Khola ramps and IEE/PPA hurdles for Mistri Khola-2 clear (currently stuck in Supreme Court-ordered IEE re-approval).
data_flag: eps_history.csv shows 082-083 full-year EPS 22.52, but MEN's own Q3 FY082-083 report (quarter ending Chaitra 2082, i.e. FY not yet closed) shows 9-month EPS 16.89 and P/E 35.46 -- these two numbers are inconsistent for a fiscal year that shouldn't be closed yet. Verify which figure present_pe_eps actually reflects before trusting present_pe/peg_ratio.
